description:
TOP REQUIREMENTS: 
 1. DataStage, SQL Server 2008 R2 or later
 2. Oracle 11gR2
 3. Experience gathering requirements for projects
 4. Prefer some architecture/modeling experience but not required
 JOB SUMMARY 

 Job comprises of various Data Integration ETL tasks with custom interfaces to external data sources & systems. This job also includes various internal Applications data load, reconciliation, on time as well as near real time data delivery tasks. Prior experience in reusable ETL interfaces is needed.  

 EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS 
 Good understanding of IBM Information server platform 
 Ability to troubleshoot ETL processes failures or warnings and provide technical support for all ETL- DataStage related issues.
 Basic Knowledge in MS-SQL Server 2008 DB.
 Strong UNIX / Linux Scripting
 Experience in SSIS preferred
 Experience with IBM CDC/ IBM® Info SphereTM Data Replication preferred
 Basic knowledge Database Netezza or Oracle preferred
 7+ years of experience in ETL-IBM Data Stage development for data movement, data quality, data cleansing and other ETL- related activities.
 DataStage Administration experience preferred
 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 

 Design and develop ETL jobs from function specification.
 Develop reusable interface frame works with reasonable assumptions of future specs.
 Performance tuning of ETL jobs to keep data loads within SLA.
 Other duties as needed.
 
 Graduation from a 4-year college or university with major course work in a discipline related to the requirements of the position is preferred. 
 
 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 3 Months CTH
